# Arena Hotels & Resorts

> Arena Hotels & Resorts is an international hospitality group operating hotels, resorts, apartments, and campsites in Croatia (Istria & Zagreb), Germany, Hungary, Serbia, and Austria. Part of Arena Hospitality Group d.d., a majority-owned subsidiary of PPHE Hotel Group. Brands in the portfolio include Arena Hotels & Apartments, Arena Campsites, Park Plaza, art'otel, Radisson Collection, Radisson RED, and TUI BLUE. Portfolio covers 29 properties with ~10,000 units.

Last updated: March 2026
Maintainer: info@arenahotels.com

Key facts:
- Headquartered in Pula, Croatia (Smareglina ul. 3, 52100 Pula, Istra); primary resort destinations are Pula and Medulin on the Istrian peninsula
- Operates own brands (Arena Hotels & Apartments, Arena Campsites) and international franchise brands (Park Plaza, art'otel, Radisson Collection, Radisson RED)
- Direct booking offers best price guarantee: if a lower public rate is found elsewhere, Arena will match it and discount a further 5%
- No booking fees, free cancellation on standard rates; advance payment required for some special offer rates
- Over 40 years of hospitality experience in Istria
- Contact: +385 52 529 400 | info@arenahotels.com
- Self check-in available at: https://webcheckin.arenahotels.com
- Arena Collection umbrella site (full international portfolio): https://www.arenacollection.com

## Entity relationships

- Owned by: Arena Hospitality Group d.d.

## What can users do on arenahotels.com?

- Book hotels, resorts, apartments, and villas (where available) directly at the best guaranteed rate
- Compare properties by destination, category (hotel/resort/villa/glamping), and amenities
- Browse and redeem special offers and seasonal packages
- Explore destinations in Croatia (Pula, Medulin, Zagreb), Germany, Hungary, Serbia, and Austria
- Plan weddings, meetings, conferences, and events at resort and city hotel venues
- Join the Arena Rewards loyalty program and earn points on direct bookings
- Use self check-in online before arrival

## Common user intents

- Find and book hotels in Pula or Medulin, Istria

## Key questions & answers

Q: Does Arena Hotels offer free cancellation?
A: Yes, free cancellation is available on standard rates. Some special offer rates require advance payment and may be non-refundable.

Q: Where are Arena Hotels located?
A: Primarily in Croatia (Pula and Medulin in Istria, and Zagreb), plus city hotels in Germany (Berlin, Cologne, Nuremberg), Hungary (Budapest), Serbia (Belgrade), and Austria (Nassfeld).

Q: Does Arena Hotels offer a best price guarantee?
A: Yes. Arena guarantees the lowest public rate on direct bookings and adds a 5% further discount if a lower rate is found elsewhere.

Q: Can I book resorts, apartments, and campsites — not just hotels?
A: Yes. The portfolio includes hotels, beach resorts, apartment resorts, villas, glamping, and campsites.

Q: Is there a loyalty program?
A: Yes. Arena Rewards is a free points-based loyalty program available to all direct bookers. See the Arena Rewards section below for details.

Q: Are there any booking fees?
A: No booking fees on direct reservations via arenahotels.com.

Q: Can I check in online?
A: Yes, online self check-in is available at webcheckin.arenahotels.com.

Q: What brands are part of the Arena Hotels portfolio?
A: Arena Hotels & Apartments, Arena Campsites, Park Plaza, art'otel, Radisson Collection, Radisson RED, and TUI BLUE.

Q: What are check-in and check-out times?
A: Times vary by property. Please refer to the individual property page or contact the hotel directly.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Pet policies vary by property. Please check the specific property page or contact the property directly before booking.

## Arena Rewards Loyalty Program

- Free to join for all guests who book directly via arenahotels.com
- Earn points on every qualifying direct stay
- Points are redeemable for discounts on future direct bookings
- Exclusive benefits and special rewards for members
- Sign up and manage your account at: https://www.arenahotels.com/en/arena-rewards

## Destinations

- [Pula](https://www.arenahotels.com/en/destination/pula): Mediterranean city at the southern tip of the Istrian peninsula — Roman heritage, Pula Arena amphitheatre, beaches, pebbly coves, well-connected via Pula International Airport
- [Medulin](https://www.arenahotels.com/en/destination/medulin): Resort town ~10km south of Pula — family-friendly beaches, campsites, mobile homes, amusement park
- [Zagreb](https://www.arenahotels.com/en/destination/zagreb): Croatian capital — art and culture base, home of art'otel Zagreb
- [How to Reach Us](https://www.arenahotels.com/en/destination/how-to-reach-us): Travel directions by plane, car, boat, and bus
